dataset_name: Karnataka Curated Hotel and Stay Research — 66 Candidates
purpose: Expanded 50-property shortlist to 66 Karnataka hotel, resort, lodge and boutique-stay candidates, prioritising properties with official property-specific photo gallery pages. Not all candidates are independently owned or fully verified.
quality_rules: Use only photographs that clearly depict the named property; reject generic destination/tourism photographs.
Prefer official property gallery or property-controlled pages.
A gallery URL is not the same as a downloaded/embedded image asset.
Do not publish photographs until written reuse permission/licence is obtained.
Do not invent missing hotel facts; null means not verified from cited source.
Check independent ownership/operator status before treating a candidate as eligible.
Verify dynamic facts such as rates, availability, policies and contacts with the property before launch.

field_guide.actual_property_photo_assets: Direct image URLs only when extracted and tied to the official source; currently most properties have a gallery URL rather than downloaded image files.
field_guide.ownership_independence_status: Conservative review flag; some candidates are operator groups, chains, or may not meet the independent-only rule.
field_guide.null: Information not verified in the research source; not an assertion that the hotel does not offer it.
